subject.title: feat: add integrations catalog for agents and editors

question: Should Crabbox adopt “Integrations” as the public umbrella taxonomy, including the documented boundary between local clients, one-shot harnesses, and future Station workloads?
rationale: This PR establishes durable product terminology and lifecycle boundaries across new public documentation; correctness of the metadata fix does not determine whether that taxonomy is the repository's intended product direction.

options.title: Split and approve the narrow fix
options.body: Keep the Agent Skills frontmatter fix and its focused documentation, while moving the broader catalog and Station terminology into a separately sponsored proposal.

options.title: Approve the catalog direction
options.body: Explicitly adopt the proposed “Integrations” umbrella and review the documentation as the authoritative public boundary.

options.title: Defer the taxonomy
options.body: Hold the catalog changes until maintainers define the preferred public integration and Station vocabulary.

recommendation.body: Keep the Agent Skills frontmatter fix and its focused documentation, while moving the broader catalog and Station terminology into a separately sponsored proposal.
